sources.snippet: Gemma 4 12B It QAT is a Quantization-Aware Training variant of Google's fourth-generation Gemma family. The model was fine-tuned from the base google/gemma-4-12B-it checkpoint with quantization-aware training targeting q4_0, making the weights more resilient to 4-bit quantization — this translates to improved perplexity and output quality ...

Designed to advance compute efficiency and reasoning, the Gemma 4 model suite features dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures, ranging from 2.3B to 31B parameters.
